title: Fireworks AI API key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: hyphen delimiter (fw- vs the documented fw_); provider code accepts only fw_/fpk_ prefixes. One community report writes fw-, recorded as a contradiction, not evidence and boundary: prefix delimiter dropped (fw + body vs the documented fw_). Twin of "Fireworks AI API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
